description: Ground-truth defects seeded into each Workbook Doctor fixture. The acceptance gate (fixture_workbook_doctor.py) asserts the scanner flags every 'must_detect' entry with the stated check + severity, and — critically — that the roll-forward trap is caught while a shape/consistency check passes the same row.

must_detect.why: =$C$5/$B$5-1 filled across years — refs never advance; D7/E7 compute the 2024 ratio for every later year.

trap_assertions.why: every cell in row 7 is structurally identical (R1C1), so a sibling-shape/consistency check PASSES the bug.
the correct contrast row (refs advance one period each step) must NOT be flagged — keeps false positives down.

must_detect.why: E6 is a typed number in the Total column where E4/E5/E7 are =SUM formulas — won't recompute and is wrong (32 vs 21).
=E7*1.15 bakes a 1.15 magic constant into a calc — an undocumented assumption.
=Data!C10 points at an empty cell — a moved/deleted precedent the result silently carries.
column B mixes € (millions), % and a bare number — not comparable/addable.
Revenue YoY % (0.12) traces to packet claim C6 (+12% YoY), which is UNSUPPORTED — no prior-year base in any source.
Headcount 1,180 traces to claim C4 / CONFLICT-003 — conflicting; the authoritative actual is 1,195.
